task: narwhal#691: Make Alloy OTLP trace enrichment trustworthy so k8s.namespace.name (and other k8s.* attributes) are determined solely by the collector from the sender TCP connection IP, stripping client k8s.* and service.namespace before k8sattributes, adding memory_limiter + node-scoped k8sattributes + internalTrafficPolicy Local, keeping 08-2-monitoring.sh parity (including Grafana OTLP address), and verifying rendered Alloy config in R371.

events.summary: Scope: gitops/charts/narwhal-apps/templates/k8s-monitoring.yaml, gitops/charts/narwhal-apps/templates/prometheus-stack.yaml, scripts/cluster/08-2-monitoring.sh, docs/common/lessons-log.md, docs/common/unified-observability-contract.md, scripts/test/lib/check-trace-k8s-attributes.py (R371), scripts/test/regression-check-kakao.sh, and this eval trace. Excluded: portal/, tempo.yaml, ClusterRoles, NetworkPolicies/PeerAuthentication, .review/, and live cluster/VM mutations.

Initial PR #729 enabled k8s-monitoring 4.2.0 applicationObservability defaults (pod_association k8s.pod.ip -> k8s.pod.uid -> connection, no node filter, no memory_limiter). Orchestrator live check (2026-11-19) from a dev pod sending resource attribute k8s.namespace.name=chaos-testing stored chaos-testing in Tempo (search chaos-testing: 1 trace; dev: 0) and was rolled back. Inspecting k8s-monitoring-4.2.0.tgz confirmed feature-application-observability hardcodes receiver -> [memory_limiter ->] resourcedetection -> k8sattributes -> transform with no pre-k8sattributes strip hook, and k8sattributes preserves pre-existing client attributes and never strips service.namespace. Also found 08-2-monitoring.sh lacked Grafana's OTLP address and R371 did not detect span-dropping filters (traces.filters.span=['true']) or render-level security invariants.

Disabled applicationObservability (enabled: false) and configured collectors.alloy-logs via extraConfig + includeDestinations: [tempo] + alloy.extraPorts (4317/4318) + service.internalTrafficPolicy: Local in k8s-monitoring.yaml and 08-2-monitoring.sh: otelcol.receiver.otlp -> otelcol.processor.memory_limiter (check_interval=1s, limit=384MiB for 512Mi container limit) -> otelcol.processor.transform 'strip_client_k8s' (error_mode=propagate, delete_matching_keys(attributes, '^k8s[.]') and delete_key(attributes, 'service.namespace')) -> otelcol.processor.k8sattributes (filter node=sys.env('HOSTNAME'), connection-only pod_association, no k8s.cronjob.name) -> tempo. Added Grafana OTLP address --set parity to 08-2-monitoring.sh, documented service.namespace deletion cost and residual unauthenticated-receiver threats in docs/common/unified-observability-contract.md and docs/common/lessons-log.md, and hardened R371 to parse and mutation-test the rendered Alloy config (including traces.filters.span=['true']).
